scope: design the next-stage executor implementation; this stage is review-only and does NOT implement execution
next_stage_purpose: implement the actual signer / wallet client / tx-send logic that the build-stage skeleton has stubbed out. The implementation MUST be gated by a fresh user approval phrase at execution time and MUST default to dry-run.
next_stage_allowed: construct a real signer (Account.from_key or LocalAccount) using a key loaded ONLY at execution time from a path the user explicitly supplies
construct a real web3.py Web3 instance pointed at the user's chosen RPC
call contract.functions.<method>().transact() to send approve / mint / decrease / collect / revoke
decode ERC721 Transfer event for tokenId
record actual fee accrual and final PnL
next_stage_still_forbidden: auto-execute: the next stage does NOT run the probe by itself; it builds the implementation; the run after that requires user re-approval
skip the re-approval at execution time: any actual send requires the user to type the approval phrase AGAIN at the moment of execution (not at build time)
ApproveMax: the implementation MUST use ApproveExact only
swap-back: the implementation MUST NOT swap WETH back to USDC
bridge: the implementation MUST NOT initiate any cross-chain bridge
live / canary / paper: the implementation MUST NOT start any of these trading modes
no multi-pool: the implementation MUST touch ONLY the frozen 0x72ab388e..
no notional > approved: the implementation MUST NOT exceed the approved notional

dry_run_does: build all tx calldata (approve + mint + decrease + collect + revoke)

next_stage_explicit_approval_gate.gating_mechanism: user must supply the approval phrase at execution time (NOT at build time)
next_stage_explicit_approval_gate.validation: regex match + whole-word dangerous-word check + cross-check against frozen candidate (same as build stage)
next_stage_explicit_approval_gate.executes_now_after_phrase_match: only if user ALSO confirms at a separate prompt ('type YES to broadcast'); this is a second gate
next_stage_explicit_approval_gate.phrase_replay_protection: session_id must be unique; re-using a session_id is rejected

next_stage_audit_trail.every_step_logged: structured JSON to local reports dir
next_stage_audit_trail.no_concealable_state: every signed tx hash is logged; the build-stage forbidden env-var check is re-run at execution time

next_stage_safety_invariants_inherited.invariant_3_dryrun_broadcast_zero: must hold at execution time too (separate dry-run confirmation phase)
next_stage_safety_invariants_inherited.invariant_4_minout_and_deadline_nonzero: deadline MUST be now+3600 (NOT 2099-01-01 placeholder) at execution time
next_stage_safety_invariants_inherited.invariant_10_post_exit_revoke: must hold; approve(NPM, 0) for both WETH and USDC after collect

review_recommendation.rationale: All 6 review dimensions (static security / mode behavior / preflight / unsigned / approval / stubs / telemetry) passed. The build-stage skeleton is safe enough to serve as the basis for a future execution implementation stage.
